# Coding Standards

Follow the rules defined in [.claude/rules-snippets/coding-standards.md](../../.claude/rules-snippets/coding-standards.md).

Key points:
- All code must follow {{LANGUAGE}} type safety rules and {{FRAMEWORK}} conventions; run linting and formatting before committing.
- Use `{{PRIMARY_PATTERN_NAME}}` for primary patterns, with consistent naming conventions for files, components, functions, and variables.
- Follow SRP and reuse-first principle: review existing utilities before implementing new functionality and prefer extending over duplicating.
